# RegenOrtho Palm Beach

## Services
- Orthopedic & Sports Medicine: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/orthopedic-sports-medicine.html — Board-certified orthopedic surgeon and sports medicine care in Palm Beach Gardens — same-day injury consultations, joint preservation, arthroscopy, and personalized recovery plans.
- Podiatric Medicine & Foot/Ankle Surgery: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/podiatric-medicine-foot-ankle-surgery.html — Board-certified podiatric surgeon in Palm Beach Gardens — minimally invasive foot & ankle surgery, same-day custom orthotics, heel pain relief, and gait correction.
- Regenerative Medicine & Orthobiologic Therapies: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/regenerative-medicine-orthobiologics.html — PRP injections, cellular and exosome therapies, peptides, and ultrasound-guided orthobiologics in Palm Beach Gardens — natural healing without surgery.
- Advanced Non-Surgical Therapies: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/advanced-non-surgical-therapies.html — EPAT shockwave, cold laser, peptide, and exosome therapies in Palm Beach Gardens — non-surgical pain relief and faster healing with minimal downtime.
- Vein Care — Medical & Cosmetic: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/vein-care.html — Ultrasound-guided vein care in Palm Beach Gardens — sclerotherapy, endovenous laser & RF ablation, phlebectomy, and cosmetic vein treatment with quick recovery.
- MISHA Knee System: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/misha-knee-system.html — The MISHA Knee System — an implantable shock absorber for medial knee osteoarthritis — offered in Palm Beach Gardens for patients not ready for knee replacement.
- Mako Robotic-Assisted Total Knee Replacement: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/mako-robotic-knee-replacement.html — Mako robotic-arm assisted total knee replacement in Palm Beach Gardens — 3D CT planning, haptic precision, and personalized implant placement by a certified surgeon.
- Neuropathy Restoration Program: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/neuropathy-program.html — The Neuropathy Restoration Program in Palm Beach Gardens — IV-enhanced, regenerative nerve repair for burning, tingling, and numbness. Non-surgical and personalized.
- Medical Weight Loss & GLP-1 Program: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/medical-weight-loss.html — Physician-supervised medical weight loss in Palm Beach Gardens — GLP-1 therapy, personalized dosing, and ongoing monitoring. Plans starting at $239/month.
- Peptide Therapy: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/peptide-therapy.html — Physician-supervised peptide therapy in Palm Beach Gardens — targeted protocols for joint & tendon repair, inflammation, sleep, skin, muscle, and immunity. From $249/month.
- Concierge & Direct-Pay Care: https://www.regenorthopb.com/services/concierge-care.html — Private concierge and direct-pay orthopedic care in Palm Beach Gardens — same-day diagnostics, private suites, transparent bundled pricing, and direct specialist access.
- IV Recovery & Wellness Lounge: https://www.regenorthopb.com/iv-therapy.html — 12 clinician-supervised infusions, $189–$499.
- Specialty Infusion Center: https://www.regenorthopb.com/infusions/index.html — IVIG, Krystexxa, Ocrevus, Ultomiris.
